name: Rod of Metamagic, Snuffinggreater
body:
Metamagic Rods | Other Rods
Rod of Metamagic, Snuffing
Source Blood of Shadows pg. 27
Aura strong (no school) CL 17th
Slot none; Price 9,000 gp (lesser), 32,500 gp (normal), 73,000 gp (greater); Weight 5 lbs.
Description
The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that extinguish magical and nonmagical sources of light active on the target as though using the Snuffing Spell feat (see page 25).
Construction
Requirements Craft Rod, Snuffing Spell; Cost 4,500 gp (lesser), 16,250 gp (normal), 36,500 gp (greater)
